messages:
sara: Heads-up — saw ~12–30s claim delays for EMEA leads after enrichment window last night. Looks like timezone jitter + RR counter reset when enrichment retries. Affected HubSpot -> Salesforce handoffs. Anyone else seeing this?

josh: Yup, saw alerts at 03:14–03:18 UTC. Queue spike + a bunch of 429s from HS. Can repro on staging.

sara: Repro steps I'm using: create inbound lead -> enrichment async callback arrives ~2–5s -> HubSpot workflow triggers round-robin assignment. If HS returns 429 on patch we retry, which appears to re-create the contact in a way that resets the RR pointer. Logs:
```
HS PATCH /contacts/12345 429 -> retry -> PATCH /contacts/12345 200
rr_counter: 42 -> 0
```

maria: Proposed mitigation:
- if enrichment delay > 10s, route into `geo-fallback` queue for manual claim
- add small RR jitter (random 0–3s) to reduce synchronized resets
- set preserve_owner flag before enrichment so SF assignment rules don't re-run
:+1:

devon: SalesOps notes: SF assignment rules currently re-evaluate on field change. We can add a `claimed_by` boolean and update enrichment workflows to avoid touching owner fields. Will coordinate with SF admin.

ana: Data requests:
- can we add metrics: `time_to_claim`, `enrichment_latency`, `rr_resets`? I'll add a dashboard if you give me sample event names.

sara: Draft HubSpot workflow snippet (staging):
```
IF enrichment_status == "pending" THEN set property preserve_owner = true
ELSE continue
```
Also add webhook guard: `if retries > 2 -> move to geo-fallback`.

josh: Ops action items:
- implement RR jitter in the claim service (small random sleep before increment)
- prevent counter reset on retry by using idempotent upsert vs recreate
- add canary rollout to 5% of inbound

maria: I'll update playbook and create a one-pager for SDRs covering geo-fallback steps and weekend coverage. Will also schedule a 30-min sync with SalesOps + Eng tomorrow 09:30 PT.

devon: I'll update SF rules and test in UAT. ETA EOD today.

ana: I'll add dashboard tiles and a daily alert if `median_time_to_claim > 8s` for EMEA.

sara: Great — thanks. Target: canary this week, full rollout next Tuesday. Tagging @devon @josh for follow-ups. :rocket:

hubspot-bot: Workflow `preserve-owner-staging` deployed to staging by maria at 2026-03-23T10:12:00Z
